Confidence Levels

Strong

Multiple reliable sources confirm existence. Missing: official images, precise dimensions, or catalog verification.

Possible

Single source or unverified photos only. May be a variant, bootleg, or misidentification. Requires corroboration.

Promotion Criteria

  
An item moves from Research to Master Archive when:

  
  

    

      
📄

      
Official Documentation

      
Catalog listing, press release, or official product page confirms existence

    

    

      
🏷️

      
Verified Tags

      
Clear photos of tush tag showing manufacturer and product code

    

    

      
👥

      
Multiple Examples

      
2+ independent examples with matching characteristics

    

    

      
✓

      
No Conflicts

      
No evidence suggesting bootleg, custom, or duplicate entry

    

  

  
  
Source Reliability Tiers

  

    
      

        Tier
        Source Type
        Notes
      

    
    
      

        S
        Official manufacturer catalog/website
        Highest reliability, direct confirmation
      

      

        A
        Physical item with clear tags
        Strong evidence, verifiable details
      

      

        B
        Major retailer listing, archived pages
        Good evidence, requires corroboration
      

      

        C
        Social media, forums, auctions
        Helpful but needs verification
